section_title: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT)
text:
When money is debited from a customer's account but the transaction fails or the beneficiary does not receive the credit:
• Mandatory Auto-Reversal TAT: Under RBI and NPCI Harmonization of TAT guidelines, failed transactions must be automatically
reversed and credited back to the customer's account within T+2 business days (where T is the transaction date).
• Delayed Reversal Compensation:
• If the reversal takes longer than T+2 business days, FinBase compensates the customer ₹100 per calendar day of delay.
• Compensation is calculated from the expiry of the T+2 window until the exact credit date, deposited directly into the customer's account
without requiring any manual claim submission.

section_title: Billing Cycle, Grace Period, and Minimum Amount Due (MAD)
text:
3.1 Interest-Free Grace Period
Cardholders enjoy an interest-free credit grace period ranging between 45 to 50 days, depending on transaction date.
The grace period is applicable ONLY if the Total Amount Due from the previous billing cycle was settled in full by the due date.
3.2 Minimum Amount Due (MAD) Calculation
• MAD is calculated as 5% of the total outstanding balance, or ₹250 (whichever is higher), plus all applicable taxes, EMI installments, and
overdue amounts from prior cycles.
• Paying only the Minimum Amount Due keeps the account in good standing with credit bureaus but attracts finance charges on the
remaining unpaid balance.
3.3 Finance Charges and Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
• Unpaid statement balances attract interest at 3.49% per month (effective 41.88% per annum), calculated from transaction date until full
realization.
• Cash advances from ATMs do not enjoy any grace period; interest accrues from the timestamp of cash withdrawal at 3.49% per month.
